List of largest cities

This list ranks the largest cities of the world by the population of their urban area, as counted by the most recent censuses and estimates. The figures are rounded, and each source counts the area of a city in its own way.

Urban areas differ from the cities proper, which follow administrative borders; see the notes below for how each figure was reached.
